interpretation_ko: 모험을 좋아하는 마음에 이끌려 뜻하지 않게 심각한 곤경에 빠질 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells you are unfortunately being led into serious complications by your love of adventure

cite.original: To dream of a pen, foretells you are unfortunately being led into serious complications by your love of adventure.
cite.translation_ko: 펜 꿈은, 모험을 좋아하는 마음에 이끌려 뜻하지 않게 심각한 곤경에 빠질 조짐이다

interpretation_en: you will be charged with a serious breach of morality

cite.original: If the pen refuses to write, you will be charged with a serious breach of morality.
cite.translation_ko: 펜이 써지지 않는 꿈은, 심각한 도덕적 잘못으로 고발당할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 짜증 나는 의무를 지고 반항하게 될 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells that you will have duties that will rile you and find you rebellious

cite.original: To dream that you have penalties imposed upon you, foretells that you will have duties that will rile you and find you rebellious.
cite.translation_ko: 벌금이나 처벌을 부과받는 꿈은, 짜증 나는 의무를 지고 반항하게 될 조짐이다

cite.original: To pay a penalty, denotes sickness and financial loss.
cite.translation_ko: 벌금을 내는 꿈은, 병과 재정적 손실을 뜻하는 조짐이다

interpretation_en: you will be victor in some contest

cite.original: To escape the payment, you will be victor in some contest.
cite.translation_ko: 벌금 내는 것을 피하는 꿈은, 어떤 다툼에서 승자가 될 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of pencils, denotes favorable occupations.

interpretation_en: foretells she will be fortunate in marriage

cite.original: For a young woman to write with one, foretells she will be fortunate in marriage, if she does not rub out words; in that case, she will be disappointed in her lover.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 연필로 글을 쓰는 꿈은, 혼인이 순조로울 조짐이다

interpretation_en: she will be disappointed in her lover

cite.original: For a young woman to write with one, foretells she will be fortunate in marriage, if she does not rub out words; in that case, she will be disappointed in her lover.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 쓴 글을 지우는 꿈은, 애인에게 실망할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 맺은 언약이 뜻하지 않게 손해로 돌아올 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes you will have engagements which will, unfortunately, result in your loss

cite.original: To dream of a penitentiary, denotes you will have engagements which will, unfortunately, result in your loss.
cite.translation_ko: 감옥 꿈은, 맺은 언약이 뜻하지 않게 손해로 돌아올 조짐이다
